notes: Documentation claim (94-100% precision, 33-66% recall without a compiler index) is not met on this project: CALLS-edge precision at high is 7/13 (53.8%); resolved-reference precision is 90.8% high, 0% medium, 50.4% low (0% if a package.json line is not accepted as a definition); recall on 40 hand-listed in-repo call sites is 12.5% at reference level and 0% at edge level.

Root cause on this codebase is definition extraction: only 'function name(){}' declarations and 'var name = function' are extracted. Express defines its API as 'app.use = function use(fn){}', so the call graph has almost nothing to bind to.
